gladiator.glance: Two-skill melee: the Overhead Slam → Rending Blow cancel is the class.
gladiator.summary: A greatsword fighter whose damage comes from two skills that cancel into each other. In top Global boss parses, Overhead Slam with its Upward Strike chain (33.5% + 27.4%) and Rending Blow with its Smashing Blow chain (9.5% + 10.8%) make up about 81% of the damage, and Ruinous Blow adds 7.8%. Everything else (stigmas, buffs) exists to make those hit harder and faster. It can also off-tank: on Global, a Gladiator took the tank seat in 55% of the Templar-less parties that have one (908 of 1,644).
brings: Passive: every Block gives you and the party +5.4% PvE damage for 20 s (level-1 value). Doesn't stack with a Templar's Fury.
Stigma level 10 adds Predation for the party for 20 s (Tenyon's Global guide runs it at 10 or more). Only 27% of top Global Gladiators slot it.
Wounded: the enemy's Attack -10% for 10 s (-20% at stigma level 10), and you get +10% PvE damage. Doesn't stack with a Templar Taunt's Shrink.
Raises Enmity (Keen Strike does too). On Global, tanking Gladiators run the same stigmas as DPS ones, so a Templar-less party doesn't need a separate tank build.
core: Pressing Rending Blow right after Overhead Slam cuts Overhead Slam's recovery. The Aug 26 balance is in the Global client and Global cast rates match it. With the Global sheet's macro, holding the macro key does the cancel by itself; Korean top players also mash Overhead Slam on its own key.
Ruinous Blow gives +20% PvE damage, +100 Crit and +15% status chance for 20 s. Open every pull with it, and recast it on cooldown (45 s).

Sword Aura Rampage only hits staggered targets: 1.2% of Global damage, used by about half of top Global Gladiators. In Korea's setup it sits directly under Rending Blow so its cancel fires on its own; on Global you press it yourself in stagger windows.

Wave Armor 10 makes Experienced Counterstrike ×1.5 and Wave Armor 15 makes Murderous Burst ×1.5, but only 15% of top Global Gladiators slot it (it is the damage 4th behind a Templar). Lunge Stance 15 makes Identify Weakness ×1.5, which mostly adds crit, and top Global Gladiators already sit at the 50% crit cap.
opener: Lunge Stance and Zikel's Blessing (20 s at level 20, 17 s at level 15; the database's 10 s is the level-1 value)
Ruinous Blow (Prepare for Battle, 20 s) and Rage Burst, so all the windows cover the burst
Hold the macro (and Keen Strike while MP is short). The Overhead Slam ↔ Rending Blow cancel happens by itself. Stay in front of the boss

Recast Ruinous Blow every 45 s and repeat the buffs on each Zikel's Blessing cooldown (120 s). Leaping Slam closes gaps. This order is derived from the durations and cooldowns; no Global source writes it down
good: Simple core: two skills carry about 81% of the damage
Self-healing: Blood Absorption restores HP on hit plus 26% of max HP at 50% HP, and Lifestealing Blade absorbs 10%
Can off-tank: in Templar-less Global parties with a Gladiator, it took the tank seat in 55% (908 of 1,644) with the same build, and tanking Gladiators died less (0.11 vs 0.29 a fight)
3rd of 8 in Global PvE: NotMeter score 110.46, +5.3% above the class average at equal CP
hard: Front melee: Experienced Counterstrike adds Front Attack Damage Boost and 77% of top Global hits land from the front, so stay in front of the boss
A hit-count rotation: FPS and ping matter (Kanon's KR/Asia test, run on other classes, found 150-200 ms of extra ping costs a lot of damage)
Overhead Slam needs a trigger: a knocked-down target, 10 s after Rage Burst, or a 7% proc per attack on knockdown-immune bosses
mistakes: Putting buffs in a second macro line: that cost 5–6% of Overhead Slam hits in an Aug 12 Korean test
Skipping the Ruinous Blow opener (Prepare for Battle is +20% PvE damage)
Stopping Ruinous Blow at 12: top Global players' median is 16 (69% at 16+). Get Overhead Slam to 20 and Rending Blow and Ruinous Blow to 16 before taking utility skills past 12
Expecting Experienced Counterstrike and a Templar's Fury to stack: they don't

templar.glance: Main tank whose damage runs through Judgment, opened by shield attacks.
templar.summary: The sword-and-shield main tank, and the only dedicated tank on Global: 64% of Global boss parses (3,400 of 5,303) have a Templar. Judgment is 42.5% of its damage in top Global parses. It has no cooldown at skill level 16, and any shield attack (Warding Strike, Shield Smite, Doom Shield, Shield Rush) opens it for 2–3 s. Templar also brings the party's best defensive tools and a damage buff that triggers when you block. Personal damage is low: NotMeter score 92.92, 6th of 8 (only Spiritmaster and Cleric are lower).
brings: Stigma: Shrink cuts the boss's Attack by 10% and Accuracy by 200, and at level 5 its PvE damage tolerance by 10%, so the whole party deals more. With Global's cooldown reduction it isn't up all the time: the median recast in logs is 33 s at level 20 and 38 s at 15–19.
Passive: every Block gives you and the party +PvE damage for 20 s: 5.5% at level 1, about 13.5% at the Global median level 17, 15% at 20 (doesn't stack with a Gladiator's Experienced Counterstrike).
On Block, Debilitate the target: Defense -25% for 5 s. It is under 1% of damage, and Defense only counts for 10% of its value in PvE, so it matters little on bosses.
Stigma: a shield worth 41% of Max HP at level 1 (55% at 15) on you and nearby party members; level 15 adds +20% PvE damage tolerance. 9–12% of Global Templars use it.

Stigma: take half the damage a party member is hit with, for 6 s. At level 20 it restores 50% of your HP when it ends, and Korea's Feb guide calls it the best party stigma. About 1% of Global Templars use it.
core: Warding Strike, Shield Smite, Doom Shield and Shield Rush are shield attacks: each opens Judgment for 2–3 s (Doom Shield 3 s). That's why they share Judgment's macro line. At skill level 16 Judgment has no cooldown.

Hold Vicious Strike (basic attack) with the macro and it cancels into Judgment. Korea's Sep 16 patch lengthened the Pummel / Punishing Strike / Judgment cancel delay and it is live on Global, so the old Pummel → Judgment cancel is slower (the exact timing is UNVERIFIED on Global). The Sep 17 Korean post uses plain Vicious + Judgment.

Any Punishment cast gives Executor: +200 Accuracy and +20% PvE damage for 20 s (30 s cooldown), charged or not. Charging only adds damage: an uncharged cast does about a third of a Max cast. Macros fire it uncharged, so keep it on its own key and charge it before the pull.
Doom Shield resets Annihilate (at stigma level 5), so Annihilate → Doom Shield → Annihilate is the top-end burst. Annihilate is 6.9% of damage.
opener: Noble Armor (recast every 2 min) and a Max-charged Punishment (Executor, 20 s)
Doom Shield (rush, opens Judgment for 3 s) → Taunt (Shrink 15 s) → Battlefield Banner (20 s at level 20); Empyrean Lord's Punishment if you slot it
Rush in, hold Vicious Strike + the macro (Judgment → Warding Strike / Shield Smite → Pummel) + the Punishment key

Annihilate → Doom Shield → Annihilate. Recast a charged Punishment every 30 s, and Taunt and Banner on cooldown. Shield of Protection every ~20 s or on boss crowd control. This order is derived from the skill durations

assassin.glance: Back-attack burst: build Insignias, detonate them, chain Heart Gore on crits.
assassin.summary: A dagger melee built around Insignia stacks and crits. Ambush (option 1), Heart Gore (option 2), the Savage Roar chain and Savage Fang (5 at once) engrave Insignias on the target. Insignia Explosion (20% of damage) detonates up to 5 stacks, and Heart Gore (28% of damage) fires again every time you crit. Illusive Clone removes Heart Gore's cooldown for 10 s at stigma level 1 (20 s at level 20), which is the burst window. You want to be behind the boss: top Global Assassins land 85% of their hits from the back.
brings: Passive: the target's Defense -12% and Status Effect Resist -11% for 10 s when you hit a staggered or impact-stunned target.
Stigma: an AoE hit that blinds NPCs 100% of the time.
Passive: Poison damage over time, plus less incoming healing on the target (PvP).
core: Ambush option 1 engraves 2 on a back hit, Heart Gore option 2 engraves 1 per hit, each skill of the Savage Roar chain (Savage Roar, Savage Back Kick, Savage Smash) engraves 1, Savage Fang engraves 5, Shadow Fall option 2 engraves 3, and Exploit Weakness clones build them too. ranger.summary: A bow DPS that plays from range with Snipe (left click) held next to the in-game macro. Marking Shot gives Precision (+300 Crit), and Deadshot hits 35% harder with it. Deadshot (23.5% of damage) has to be charged by hand: the in-game macro fires it uncharged, about a third of a Max cast by the tooltip (599 vs 1,798). Slow and Root effects make Burst Arrow, Explosive Arrow and the Rooting Eye passive hit harder. Few actives need to reach 20, so passives carry a lot.

core: Marking Shot gives +300 Crit for 10 s (15 s with option 3) and Deadshot +35% damage while it's up. Cast it standing still and keep it up yourself; don't spam it.

Tempest Shot is your held-filler spam (16.6% of Global damage). It sits under Drill Dart in the same macro line in both the Global sheet and the Korean Aug 30 post, so the older 'Tempest Shot in its own entry' rule is not used here. Arrow Scattershot is for broken (staggered) bosses only: it refills cooldowns, HP and MP.
Burst Arrow only fires on Slowed or Rooted targets. Explosive Arrow and Rooting Eye hit harder on them.

Deadshot has 3 charge levels (23.5% of damage). The in-game macro can't fire stage 3, so charge it yourself while holding Snipe + the macro. Global macro-only parses land at roughly 40–90% of a Max cast per cast, a small sample (4 players).

sorcerer.glance: Ranged nuker: fully charged Hellfire after Delayed Explosion, plus ground AoEs.
sorcerer.summary: A spellbook caster with the highest ceiling among ranged classes: 2nd at equal CP on Global (+9.8% vs the average). It's also the least forgiving: low HP, no block, slow animations and ground AoEs that miss when the boss moves. Damage is spread over many skills (Hellfire 21.7%, Blaze 14.7%, Fire Wall 13.1%, Bittercold Wind 9.2%, Firestorm 8.9%, Cold Storm 6.5% of top Global damage), so missing any one of them hurts. Skills cut each other's cooldowns (Firestorm → Hellfire, Blaze → Wish of Concentration, Wish → everything), which is why it relies on cooldown reduction more than any other class.
brings: Stigma: ground AoE that slows, with Frostbite damage over time (up to 4 within 5 m). Before Oct 13 a stronger Frostbite from another player removed yours; the Oct 13 patch stopped that, and whether two Sorcerers' Frostbites stack is unconfirmed.
Stigma: ground AoE with Embers damage over time (up to 4 in a 1×10 m wall, +2 m width at 10).
Option 3: +20% PvE damage for 5 s when it lands (you only).
core: Delayed Explosion makes the target take +15% damage from you for 4 s (+10% more at stigma 20). Land your fully charged Hellfire inside that window. Since Aug 26 it also works on the ground AoEs in Korea; that is not confirmed on Global.

Blaze only hits targets with Fire Mark. Korea's Sep 16 patch made Fire Mark apply on every Fire attack (it was 20% of them), stopped Blaze from consuming it, and changed Flame Arrow option 4 (Pyroclasm, skill level 12) from 'applies Fire Mark' to +5% Fire damage for 10 s. Option 4 is live on Global: the buff shows in 275 of 282 top parses with it and in none without. Questlog's Global skill text agrees on both changes, but the aion2.app database still says 20%, and the Fire Mark application rate can't be read from the logs (UNVERIFIED). Flame Arrow option 5 (skill level 16) resets Blaze's cooldown.

Wish of Concentration option 5 (16) cuts all cooldowns by 10 s. Firestorm option 4 cuts Hellfire by 2 s per fireball (5 fireballs per use in Global parses), and Blaze option 5 cuts Wish by 3 s per hit. Global maximum cooldown reduction is only about 19–21% (Korea 34–40%). Est's minimum for full Wish uptime and the Bittercold Wind breakpoint is 25.6%, which Global can't reach yet; that's why Est tells Global players to weave Ice Chain.

spiritmaster.glance: Summoner: four spirits on timers feed Elemental Fusion and Jointstrikes.
spiritmaster.summary: An orb caster who fights with four spirits. Each spirit's skill gives you an element. At 4 stacks you get Four Elements and can fire Elemental Fusion (17.0% of damage). Combustion (7.6%) with its Ashy Call chain (6.8%) and Dimensional Control (7.5%) fill in around it. Jointstrikes add a spirit follow-up on top of your own hit. The Ancient Spirit (90 s cooldown, lasts 30 s) is the burst window: its attacks are about 15% of damage, and Global's low cooldown reduction (about 19–21%) leaves it substantial downtime. A large share of damage comes from the spirits themselves, and Sirin says the class 'performs very well on high ping'.
brings: Taunts (+3,750 Enmity) and can hold adds.
Damage over time, and the target deals 10% less damage to you.
The target takes +10% damage from your spirit for 20 s.
core: Every spirit skill adds an element. At 4 you can fire Elemental Fusion; in Sirin's Global macro it sits as its own entry. The Ancient Spirit grants Four Elements every time it uses its skill.

Cycle Water → Earth → Wind → Fire. That builds the element stacks for Fusion, and each summon enables Dimensional Control. Water → Earth first keeps skills from being eaten and the Fire Spirit up (Korean guides). Wind Spirit has been in Sirin's rotation since Oct 6.

Cast Enhance: Spirit's Benediction (and Flame Blessing if slotted) before summoning the Ancient Spirit: stats are snapshotted onto spirits when they're summoned. Then Jointstrike: Corrode, and a fully charged Destructive Attack if slotted. Since Sep 10 (KR/TW) its spirit follow-up fires instantly.

With specialty option 4, Cold Shock's Earth Tremor chain stacks +2% Attack up to 5 times, so keep the 5-stack buff running. Element Unification stacks Crit Damage up to 5 times on landed spirit-skill hits. Fight from about 3 m (Korean guides).
opener: Enhance: Spirit's Benediction (+ Flame Blessing if slotted), then Summon: Ancient Spirit (90 s cooldown, 30 s). Each Ancient skill grants Four Elements
Jointstrike: Corrode (the target takes +10% damage from the spirit for 20 s), then Jointstrike: Destructive Attack at max charge if slotted
Cycle Water → Earth → Wind → Fire spirits and weave Cold Shock (held), Combustion, Dimensional Control and Jointstrike: Curse

cleric.glance: Healer with real damage: Chain of Torment opens Condemnation, Earth Punishment makes it crit.
cleric.summary: A mace healer, and the healer of record on Global: exactly one Cleric is in 86% of boss parses (4,562 of 5,303). Condemnation (35.6% of damage, 3 s cooldown) only hits targets with Chain of Torment, always crits on targets with Earth Punishment, and resets on a crit (option 4). Judgment Thunder with its Divine Punishment chain adds 23.4%. Healing is manual. NotMeter ranks Cleric's personal damage last (8th of 8: score 69.41, -25.6% at equal CP; 66.98 and still 8th after the Oct 13 patch), but it measures damage only and has no Global healing ranking. A Korean guide author reports that Cleric's attack speed caps at 94.4% while other classes reach about 121.6% (Korea; UNVERIFIED on Global).

core: Condemnation (35.6% of damage) only hits targets with Chain of Torment, which is why Chain sits in the same macro line. Option 4 resets its cooldown on every crit: the top 10% log about 42 uses a minute.

chanter.glance: Support melee: party buffs plus Dark Crush, opened by ranged skills.
chanter.summary: A staff fighter who buffs the whole party and still deals solid damage: the top Global class, with a NotMeter score of 118.79 (1st of 8) and +22.0% at equal CP (1st); 114.08 and still 1st after the Oct 13 patch. Its mantras and Power of the Storm are some of the strongest party buffs in the game. Its damage runs through Dark Crush, which opens for 2 s after ranged skills since the Aug 26 rework (31.5% of damage with its Piercing Strike chain). One macro entry plus a held Onslaught covers most of it, which makes it the easiest high-damage class on Global right now. Without a Cleric it is also the main healer: in 524 of the 526 Cleric-less parties with any healing between players, the Chanter gave the most.

Enemy PvE damage tolerance -5.4% at level 1, -9% at 10, -11% at 15 and -13% at 20. It doesn't apply together with a Cleric's Chain of Torment.

Party heal + cleanse (1 debuff), with a heal over time. 15 s cooldown. Without a Cleric it is most of the party's healing.
core: Spinning Strike and Impactful Crush each open Dark Crush for 2 s (Marchutan's Wrath for 3 s). With option 5 at skill level 16 Dark Crush has no cooldown, so every macro turn inside a window fires it. Spinning Strike also stacks +15% Crit Damage (×2, 30 s).
Toggles never go in a macro
Undefeated Mantra and Sprint Mantra are toggles. A second press switches them off, so keep them on their own keys.

Use Gust Rampage only while the stagger bar is up: at skill level 16 it takes 1 s off all cooldowns per hit. Gust Rampage users measured 6–9% lower at equal CP (NotMeter can't tell when it was used), and the sheet lists it as N/A. Korean players hold it with the macro for the stagger cancel.
Guardian Blessing has a 2-min cooldown on live Global (Sep 16): Chanters recast it in 85 of 93 fights longer than 130 s. Recast it with Power of the Storm so it's never forgotten.

Arcana: Chalice Time · Parchment Life/Destiny · Compass Death/Freedom · Bell Destruction · Mirror Illusion/Wisdom, with the sheet's skill lines per card in the table below; daevaos agrees: +4 levels in total on Dark Crush and Onslaught from Chalice and Parchment, +4 on Recuperation from the Compass, and the highest Attack Preparation roll on the Bell. Questlog's Global Arcana data: each card comes in a Vigor and a Magic variant (Chalice Time / Space, Parchment Life / Destiny, Compass Freedom / Death, Bell Justice / Destruction, Mirror Illusion / Wisdom), so the sheet's Time, Life, Freedom and Illusion picks are the four Vigor cards. Set bonuses: 2 Vigor cards +60 PvE Attack and 4 +150 PvE Attack while HP is 70% or more; 2 Magic cards restore 1,500 MP at 20% MP or less (30 s cooldown) and 4 give +1,000 PvE Defense at 50% MP or more. 73 of 92 public endgame-level builds wear 3+ cards, mostly Unique at level 4-5: Chalice of Vigor 57, Parchment of Vigor 52, Compass of Vigor 39, Mirror of Vigor 38, Bell of Magic 29 (Bell of Vigor 23). Lines each card can roll: Parchment Onslaught, Rushing Smash, Wave Blow, Heat Wave Blow, Dark Crush or Spinning Strike; Compass Incandescent Blow, Impactful Crush, Tremor Crush, Recuperation, Gust Rampage or Defiance; Bell Blessing of Life, Protection Circle, Attack Preparation, Raging Spell or Survival Willpower; Mirror Crossguard, Inspiring Spell, Impact Hit, Earth's Promise or Wind's Promise; Chalice any of the 22 skills; each line is +1 level, up to +4. Players mostly pick Dark Crush on the Chalice; Spinning Strike, Dark Crush and Onslaught on the Parchment; Incandescent Blow and Recuperation on the Compass; Attack Preparation on the Bell; Impact Hit, Wind's Promise and Earth's Promise on the Mirror. roadmap: Go through MSQ to 45 and do some of these while at it or come back later:
1. Sealed Dungeons - these give daevanation crystals for your board + skill points
2. Regional Quests - give daevanation crystals + gear
3. Feathers - scrolls for leveling your amulet + stamina + amplification stone shards
4. Strongholds - scrolls for leveling your belt
5. Rifting - sealed dungeons & strongholds in enemy faction (PvP is togglable)
Go straight into the abyss to grab feathers and your weekly quests
Buy a ring once you have enough abyss points
Finish any side stuff you haven't completed (Feathers are 188 of them)
All pieces to +10 and Manastones (should be around ~1400 score) enough for Vakron Sky Island (2* exploration dungeon)
IF it's like KR/TW, Go to the Rift every 3 hours for extra strongholds and dungeons.
Do Vakron until you get the full set. IF you have 7/8 pieces and far from pity, do the expedition version instead to hit pity.
Get all Green Cards (Blues are a bonus)
Level up your belt and amulet to squeeze some extra gear score and get some more bulk and damage (should be around ~1920 score)
Farm Deus till you get all blue cards with ideally some of your main skills to +16 (should be around ~2190 Score)
Farm Kromede to finish your Accessories
If you are not able to craft the Splendent Dark Dragon Lord weapon then just go for the Kromede weapon or something of similar ilvl until you can replace it
Farm Ferocious Horn Den to finish your Guard and Armor pieces (Armor will be used all of season 1). All to +10. (Should be around ~2560).
Ideally stage 4 but 3 is fine. Farm this till you get all Yellow Cards with the proper skills for your class to hit level 20 on those skills in preparation for Ludra
